note.es: Corrida 02:30 CT domingo (finde, franja pre-london lun-vie no aplica hoy, solo vigila salud). Snapshot 11 min, scalp ok (ingest 12m/snapshot 41m), news 12 min (22 eventos). Mercado de futuros cerrado desde el viernes ~22:01 UTC: orb/feed/regime/trendcl del resto del complejo paran ~2081 min solo por el cierre de finde, no es caida (status topado en warn). Feed de ES sigue muerto desde antes del cierre normal (empezo viernes ~10:10 UTC, ya ~47 h), la dead streak persiste y se repite el aviso: revisar su alerta/export en TradingView. check_pushes.py (ventana 26h) marca 8 rutinas sin commit visible (crypto-close, crypto-ny, weekly, 4 watchdogs y zones-agent del 13/14-nov); el historial de git de main se volvio a comprimir en un commit raiz el 14-nov ~22:07 CT (solo quedan 50 commits desde ahi, todo el contenido de archivos sigue intacto en el working tree), asi que es limite de ventana/historial tras el squash, no fallo real de las rutinas. Journal sin refrescar desde 2026-11-08, no cuenta en finde.

Futures market closed since Friday ~22:01 UTC: the rest of the complex's orb/feed/regime/trendcl idle ~2081 min just from the weekend close, not an outage (status capped at warn). ES feed has been dead since before the normal close (started Friday ~10:10 UTC, now ~47h), the dead streak persists and the alert repeats: check its TradingView alert/export. check_pushes.py (26h window) flags 8 routines with no visible commit (crypto-close, crypto-ny, weekly, 4 watchdog runs and the Nov13/14 zones-agent); main's git history was squashed into a new root commit again on Nov-14 ~22:07 CT (only 50 commits remain from there, all file content stays intact in the working tree), so this is a window/history limit after the squash, not a real routine failure. Journal not refreshed since 2026-11-08, doesn't count on weekends.
